title: Admin can log in and reach dashboard
description: Verifies that an admin can submit valid credentials on the admin login page and land on the dashboard with navigation available.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Verify the user lands on the admin dashboard and sidebar navigation is visible

title: Browse pack details from listing and add to cart
description: Verifies a guest can open a pack from the listing, review details, add it to the cart, and see it in the cart drawer.
category: Pack Details (Browse and Add to Cart)

steps.description: Navigate to /packs
Click a pack from the listing to view its details
Scroll through the pack details section
Add the pack to the cart
Open the cart drawer
Verify the cart drawer shows the added pack as a cart item

title: Start checkout from cart drawer and choose MercadoPago
description: Verifies a guest can move from the cart drawer to checkout, select MercadoPago as the payment method, and initiate the pay action without client-side validation blocking.

steps.description: Navigate to /packs
Add a pack to the cart directly from the listing
Open the cart drawer
Proceed to checkout from the cart drawer
Select MercadoPago as the payment method
Submit the pay action
Verify the checkout flow proceeds past the pay initiation step without showing a form validation error

title: Discover packs from home and browse full catalog
description: Verifies a guest can land on the home page, see pack discovery content, navigate to the packs catalog, and see the full pack list rendered.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the pack listing section
Click the navigation control to view all packs
Verify the user lands on the packs catalog page
Verify a list of available packs is displayed

title: Download purchased pack from success page
description: Verifies that a buyer can open the success page, see available downloads with expiry info, and start a token-based download from a link.

steps.description: Navigate to /success
Wait for the success page content to load
Scroll to the downloads section
Click a download link for a purchased pack
Verify a download is initiated or the browser navigates to a download endpoint

title: Add a pack to cart directly from the listing and review in cart drawer
description: Verifies a guest can add a pack to the cart from the packs listing page and confirm the cart drawer shows the correct cart contents.
category: Pack Details (Browse and Add to Cart)

steps.description: Navigate to /packs
Add a pack to the cart directly from the listing
Open the cart drawer
Review the cart items list
Verify the cart drawer displays at least one cart item

title: Admin creates a new pack successfully
description: Verifies an admin can create a new pack from the create-pack page and sees a visible success confirmation after submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation link to create a pack
Fill "Autotest Pack" into the pack name field
Fill a valid price into the price field
Submit the create pack form
Verify a success confirmation is visible

title: Admin can navigate dashboard to create-pack and sales and back
description: Verifies that an authenticated admin can use the dashboard sidebar to navigate to create-pack and sales pages and return to the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Click the navigation item to go to create pack
Click the navigation item to go back to the dashboard
Click the navigation item to go to sales
Verify the sales list view is displayed

title: Admin can create a pack and then find it in the public packs listing
description: Verifies a newly created pack appears in the public packs listing after creation, indicating it is published and visible to buyers.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation link to create a pack
Fill "Autotest Pack Public" into the pack name field
Fill a valid price into the price field
Submit the create pack form
Click the link to return to the public packs page
Verify the pack named "Autotest Pack Public" is visible in the packs listing

title: Cart persists while navigating between catalog and details
description: Verifies a guest’s cart contents remain visible after navigating from the catalog to a pack details page and reopening the cart drawer.
category: Pack Details (Browse and Add to Cart)

steps.description: Navigate to /packs
Add a pack to the cart directly from the listing
Click a pack from the listing to view its details
Open the cart drawer
Verify the cart drawer still shows the previously added cart item

title: Admin sales page is protected when logged out
description: Verifies an unauthenticated user cannot access the sales admin page and is redirected to admin login.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/sales
Verify the admin login page is displayed

title: Open a pack details page from the home preview
description: Verifies a guest can open a pack’s details page from the home page preview and see the pack’s information and images.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to the pack listing section
Click a pack card to view its details
Verify pack information is displayed
Verify pack images are displayed

title: Admin create-pack page is protected when logged out
description: Verifies an unauthenticated user cannot access the create-pack page and is redirected to admin login.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/create-pack
Verify the admin login page is displayed

title: Admin can log out and return to login
description: Verifies that an authenticated admin can log out from the dashboard and is returned to the admin login page.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Fill {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}} into the password field
Submit the login form
Trigger logout from the dashboard
Verify the admin login page is displayed

title: Admin can view sales and paginate through records
description: Verifies an admin can open the sales page, view the sales table, and move between pages to see different records.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation link to view sales
Wait for the sales list to load
Navigate to the next page of sales results
Verify the sales table is displayed

title: Admin can search sales and open a sale from the list
description: Verifies an admin can use the sales search and open a sale from the results when available.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation link to view sales
Wait for the sales list to load
Fill a valid search term into the sales search field
Submit the sales search
Open the first sale from the results list
Verify sale details are displayed for the selected sale

title: Prevent checkout initiation when no payment method is selected
description: Verifies the checkout page blocks initiating payment until a payment method is selected and shows a visible validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /packs
Add a pack to the cart directly from the listing
Open the cart drawer
Proceed to checkout from the cart drawer
Submit the pay action without selecting a payment method
Verify a payment method validation error is visible

title: Admin login requires password
description: Verifies that submitting the admin login form without a password shows a required-field validation error and does not log the user in.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Fill {{LOGIN_USER}} into the email field
Submit the login form
Verify a password required validation error is visible

title: Admin is required to provide a pack name
description: Verifies the create-pack form blocks submission when the pack name is missing and shows a required-field validation error.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation link to create a pack
Leave the pack name field empty
Submit the create pack form
Verify a validation error is visible indicating the pack name is required

title: Admin sees an empty state for sales search with no matches
description: Verifies searching sales with a term that yields no matches shows a clear empty state instead of stale results.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Click the navigation link to view sales
Wait for the sales list to load
Fill "zzzz-no-matches-123" into the sales search field
Submit the sales search
Verify an empty state is displayed indicating there are no matching sales
